purpose: Design of the backend-independent part of the /forge:review skill: backend resolution, targets and allowlist, fix safety verification, location-based split, termination, and staged presentation.
summary: Architecture: SKILL orchestrates scripts, exchange scripts, reviewer and evaluator agents, backend SKILL and consult
Backend resolution by name to forge:<name> SKILL, explicit specification fails closed, default candidate order agent-review
.forge.yaml review section has only a backend key; candidate order is not configurable
Module list and base branch hand-off to resolve_targets for consistent allowlist
Single exit for termination across approved, halted_with_open_findings, failure and interrupted
Handling of reviewer and evaluator results, and preserving target granularity in requests
Request-specific focus and scope axes, and bringing in project rules and specs
Fix safety verification, immutable requests, and no resumption of interrupted reviews
Location-based split and two kinds of confidence (fix_confident and confidence), finding-evaluation mapping
Staged presentation delegated to consult, use cases, test design and open items
tasks: Modifying the /forge:review SKILL or its scripts
Designing review termination and cleanup behavior
Changing auto-fix, safety verification or allowlist logic
Writing tests for review body scripts
Reviewing changes to staged presentation and consult delegation
title: DES-066 `/forge:review` 本体（バックエンド非依存部）設計書
